$comment: Official list-price API equivalent policy data, not invoices, subscriptions, or third-party channel bills. Keys are provider/model ids. input, cached, and output are USD per 1,000,000 tokens at the original model vendor's published API reference price. source is the public pricing page; basis states the equivalence and any excluded surcharge. lib/router/official-rate-value.mjs reads this file at module load; change rates here, never in code.
note: 按各模型开发商官方 API 价格估算，非订阅或第三方渠道实际账单。历史 DeepSeek 统一按高峰价；OpenAI、xAI 的长上下文附加费、Google 缓存存储费、工具费用及缓存写入费用无法从模型累计 Token 还原，均未计入。
